steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: This is how you do it, right? Aim at the enemy, then—

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Bloody hell.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Relax, Tommy. It's not much different from the machines you worked day after day, in that both can make a mess out of you in an instant. Just remember to keep the safety engaged when you're not using it.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Ha, haha.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Where did that white-haired Feline get all this stuff with things the way they are now?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Look at the...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Catherine?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I'm fine. Chronic stuff.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Look at the dust on these weapons. They're brand-new, but they've been in storage for a while.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: This isn't standard-issue military stuff, more like custom weapons for special operations, and they weren't made by Londinium factories

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Looks like Millscar is more than just your average gangster.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Do you mean she's an informant for somebody big? So, she's willing to trade weapons with us because—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Don't expect to play an important role in their games. These stuff were probably meant for something else, and she came to us only after that fell through.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Or maybe Millscar raided some duke's secret arsenal in Londinium and selflessly decided to share it with people in need. Who knows?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What she's after doesn't matter to us. We're just taking things one step at a time.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: We've sent a few scouts out since the sky turned red. For some reason, all the Sarkaz soldiers seemed to have pulled out of Highbury.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: That doesn't mean we're safe. Quite the contrary, it means the Sarkaz don't care about managing the city anymore. Factories, production lines... none of these matter to them anymore.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: I had a look at Magna Borough yesterday. It's been turned into a huge Arts Circle...

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Hundreds if not thousands are trapped in their strange witchcraft, fueling the Sarkaz altars.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: At this rate, it won't be long before it's our turn.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: What are you planning? Should we get that thing we've been building out there, and—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Don't be silly. Just because you got some decent gear doesn't mean you suddenly became a commando.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We have a few decent weapons. They'll allow us to defend ourselves if the Sarkaz come for us, no more than that.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We must—
'Wait for an opportunity.'
When do you think that opportunity is going to come, though?

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Wh-Who are you? How did you find this place?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: ...I've seen your clothes.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You went to all that effort to sneak into Londinium at a time like this, even investigating our background... what do you need with a few old workers, now?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Reunion?
The 13th ventilation tunnel is running. There are marks on the 54th ropeway.
I suggest you double-check. If we can find it, so can the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Oh, my name's Nine, by the way. And yes, I'm with Reunion.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Thanks for the heads up.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Did you come all this way beneath Londinium just to tell us this?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We want to know how long you plan to wait.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We have folks who used to work in Sudean Borough. They say the workers of Londinium were always proud that they built this great city.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: But has it ever truly belonged to you, past or present?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Madam Catherine, your condition—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I've heard the stories. I'll give you credit where it's due, but spare me that crap about the non-Infected taking everything from you. I'm not interested.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What are a few rocks here and there in today's Londinium? We have a lot more to worry about.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Infected or uninfected... none of that matters in Londinium now.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: So, are you planning to take back the city?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: From all who stood idly by while all this happened, from the people who allowed things to get to this point.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Londinium is filled with Originium dust. Many will become sick and die because of it.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: The culprit will be made to pay, whoever they are, whether they have rocks growing out of them or not.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: Reunion won't wait at the finish line. Not anymore.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: You're—

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Hey, Tommy! Remember me?

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Mayore! I thought you got sick and—oh, so that's how you ended up with Reunion.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Well, I'm back. Here, Oripathy prevention pills. Take one per day. There's only so much it can do, though, so you'd better pray that your luck's good.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: You guys...

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: To tell you the truth... your look when you left the factory... I thought you would have loved nothing more than for all of us to become Infected like you.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Maybe I really did.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: But it wasn't you who lost me my job. Wasn't Catherine, either. I know you lot tried to put in a good word for me, but those were the rules.

steps.name: Reunion Member A
steps.text: Maybe not anymore, though.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: There's a lot we can help with—using and maintaining equipment, operating in high-Originium environments, tactics, covert operations. Anything you need.

steps.name: Nine
steps.text: We'll help you liberate this place, if you'll let us... from the people who saw all this as nothing more than the 'price of business'.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We'll take the city back, with or without you, Nine of Reunion.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We look forward to working with you.

steps.name: A Distant Voice
steps.text: Aefanyl...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Mother?

steps.name: Blurred Silhouette
steps.text: My child...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Have you come to see me off?

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: You're badly hurt, my child.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I lost.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I did all I could, but I still lost.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But I have no regrets about the path I chose, nor doubts about the ideals I believed in.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...But I'm sorry I let you down.

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: Why say that?

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: You have defeated so many powerful foes. How long has it been since the Court of the Banshees had a warrior and sovereign so strong, so steadfast?

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: The Court is proud of you. So am I, even if you reject the traditions of the Royal Court.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I ask one last thing... please, sing an elegy for me...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Mother?

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: Not so fast, my lazy boy.

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: It's not bedtime yet.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: But I'm—

steps.name: Laqeramaline
steps.text: Rise and shine, Aefanyl.

steps.name: Banshee-Style Device
steps.text: Up yet, sleepy-head?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Mother?

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Good, you still recognize my voice.

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: How about a kiss for your dear mother on the cheek? It's been so long, after all.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I... I don't think...

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This strange contraption... were you always by my side?

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Me? Of course not. A mother should let her son roam free, once he's all grown up.

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Just a little token of love to record important moments in your life for me.

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: I will say, I was a little surprised it recorded not just your performance in battle, but you putting this outfit on...

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Hm... I know, Her Highness Theresa liked it this way, but...

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Never mind. As long as you like it.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You're bothered by what I'm wearing? When this device of yours...

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Isn't it adorable?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: A Banshee should value her words, rather than waste them on disputing the aesthetics of a gadget.

steps.name: Gentle but Stern Voice
steps.text: How could you say that!

steps.name: Gentle but Stern Voice
steps.text: Think of all the love that your mother and sisters put into it! Is this how you repay our affection?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Thank you, Mother.

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: Go. Your friends are waiting.

steps.name: Kindly Voice
steps.text: I'm so proud of you.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Intimidating roar)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's a dead end! Sheer cliff ahead!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, from the Shard...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're too late.
The last vestige of Teekaz fades away.
But it had gotten an answer, a recognition, a response.
The sensation was subtle at first.
But the clouds no longer converged upon the pinnacle of the Shard, replaced by something else.
The branches and vines began to bear red fruit.
It is a bizarre scene, but somehow it inspires comfort rather than fear, as though this is how it should be, how it always has been.
The world seems to have always been like this; all that has happened is that someone had removed the back cover of a clock by accident, revealing the springs and gears underneath.

Originium is an integral part of Terra's ecology. Originium in the atmosphere bring about Catastrophe, and Originium in the body cause sickness. Even insects know to cover themselves in hard shells of Originium.
The coexistence of Originium and Terra is an immutable law, just like how two parallel lines can never intersect.
But where did Originium come from?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Confessarii's control over Amnannam exceeds our expectations. We're one step too late.

options: Will it become a weapon for the Sarkaz?
Can the Sighs of Kings still fight it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No... Amnannam brings more than Catastrophe, and it's far more than a weapon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's not just the origin of the Sarkaz... in fact, one could say it's the origin of everything in Terra.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This may be the greatest crisis we've ever seen... maybe the greatest crisis Terra has ever seen.

options: We need to find a way out of here first!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Lifebone. W is there. We can seek the Feranmut's help!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let me try to get in touch with W—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, I'm not getting through—

steps.name: W's Voice
steps.text: Hello? Hello? ...Finally!

steps.name: W's Voice
steps.text: ...Bunny... where...

steps.name: W's Voice
steps.text: Almost... Manfred... Hoederer has...

steps.name: W's Voice
steps.text: The agreed time...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: W! They're alive!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But the interference is too strong...

steps.name: W's Voice
steps.text: ...Where? How did—

options: Find where the biggest commotion is! That's where we are!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lost contact.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What did you mean by 'commotion', Doctor?

options: And what catches W's attention like nothing else?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Unreasonably risky.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But... worth a try.
Twelve hours ago...
Fifty-eight hours into the operation...

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier
steps.text: Sir, we've taken control of the Lifebone's central area.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Examine the skeleton and eliminate any resistance. Tell Nadine to clean up the remaining mercenaries outside. Leave no survivors.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Set up defenses around the skeleton and rig it with explosives.

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier
steps.text: Do you mean to...?

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier
steps.text: ...Yes, Sir!
The blood reaches Manfred's feet. He takes one glance at the body on the ground, then turns and leaves the room.

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier A
steps.text: What to do with enemy mercenaries that we captured in the Lifebone, sir?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is this all of them?

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier A
steps.text: Yes, sir. Many of them previously served the Military Commission.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Kill them all.

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier A
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Show yourself.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: G-General Manfred...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...Paprika.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Was I supposed to see you here?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I was captured by the mercenaries here while transporting a shipment.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I had to protect my squad...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: That doesn't explain why you didn't respond when the Military Commission attacked this skeleton.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: And what were you doing hiding here?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I... I was just afraid.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hmph. Afraid.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your previous mission is over, Paprika.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Your new mission is to execute these traitors to the Military Commission.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: But... but they're prisoners, defenseless—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As warriors, they're traitors to their cause. As mercenaries, they've unilaterally broken their contract. One way or the other, they must pay the price.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: B-But they're in no position to resist anymore. They're no threat to you.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What meaning is there to all this killing? Didn't you say yourself that you wanted as many Sarkaz to go home as possible—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I gave you a chance, Paprika. I've been very patient.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You're not the first one to disappoint me today.

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier B
steps.text: General!

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier B
steps.text: The engineers have examined the Lifebone. The structure is largely intact, and the mercenaries don't have the means to make direct modifications. However...

steps.name: Royal Court Soldier B
steps.text: We found a large amount of explosives that were not set by us.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Explosives?

steps.name: Royal Court Scout
steps.text: Unable to reach Lieutenant General Nadine, sir!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That hard-headed Hoederer can come in useful once in a while. You really did lead an attack squad, Manfred.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is this our first formal meeting? I guess I should introduce myself. I'm from Babel, and I'm here to take your life. You can call me W.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A mercenary from Hoederer Squad...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You came back to die?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Die?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Pfft. Have you thought for a moment that why your attack has gone a little too smoothly? Where did you think all the mercenaries went?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who's surrounded now?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You think this rabble can stand against the soldiers of the Military Commission?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I hope your bones are as hard as your words.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Because I'll blow your head off before your soldiers can even knock on the door.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hmph...
Manfred begins to swing, but shadows entangle his feet. Then bombs explode all around him before he can break free.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Aim, W!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Stop complaining! I told you I'm good at controlling explosions!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: *cough*—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You're trying to destroy the skeleton—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, is that not very convenient?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm not sentimental like Hoederer is. I have absolutely no problem making this big pile of bones your grave.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I wonder what Theresis would be sadder about: Losing this big guy, or losing his favorite foster son.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You think I'd let you do that?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...Not a moment too soon.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ascalon?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You look...
The bloodied assassin stops the foe's sword, not the slightest hint of wavering in her sleeve-blade.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You're not ready to kill me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Cut off this guy's golden head, Ascalon, and I'll listen to anything you say for a whole year!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I've asked you this question before, Ascalon. What do you believe in?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...I believe that our differences end here and now.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: And this time, there will be no mistake.
Seventy hours into the operation...

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Huff*... *huff*... won't let me have a breather.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Crane! Where are you guys? You were supposed to be guarding the top of the spine. Why do troops keep dropping down—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, Crane's dead. Damned Manfred. I think I have a concussion.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ascalon—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She's outside.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Looks like we're bringing a whole bunch of dead bodies with us. Great.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W! Am I seeing this right? Is this nerve bundle glowing?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Did the Doctor's team make it?

steps.name: *Radio Noise*
steps.text: W—

steps.name: *Radio Noise*
steps.text: Try—take off—

steps.name: *Radio Noise*
steps.text: —biggest commotion—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: They're trying to reach us!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ines, is Hoederer still breathing?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: (Weak breathing)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The bleeding's stopped, at least.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Then wake him up and get him to put his Feranmut friend to work!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You're asking too much—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Fine, maybe Hoederer needs to lie down a little longer. Well, this guy has been lying down long enough.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bonesy! Wake up! How do you like this alarm clock?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W, you lunatic! Hoederer is wounded!
Explosions echo in the chamber, followed by a rumbling, muddled voice.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Mm?

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Oh, it's you. The Sarkaz historian. What happened to your face? Did your great adventure not go well?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, shut up! Get us out of here if you don't want your last bones blown to smithereens! And shake those Royal Court fleas off you if you can.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Oh, I forgot. My body's still here.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: The flea part is a little too much to ask. You all look the same size to me.

steps.name: Muddled Voice
steps.text: Mm. I suppose we should go.
The voice sighs, stirring up a turbulence in the fabric of time and space.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: ...This round is mine.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I have no intention of gloating. It took too much time, and... you've never been so weak before.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The previous battle had taken its toll on you, and this type of operation is not your forte.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We've both missed opportunities.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A new Kazdel is complete. You know that, Ascalon. You know that you are fighting against our own future.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Future, you say.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You say I never saw clearly what our sovereign was thinking.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: But I understand now.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Someone will complete the work that she left unfinished. Amiya, Kal'tsit... I will remove all obstacles that stand in their way.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How blind and stubborn. Why do you not understand that this was Lady Theresa's wish too?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: We're enemies, no more, no less. We've long passed the point of no return.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Lifebone is activating? How could—

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You've failed. You can't stop us anymore.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: This skeleton will be destroyed.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No one can threaten the future that His Highness will bring to Kazdel.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Even if neither of us will live to see it.
Manfred throws down his sword and takes out the detonation switch. He places his finger on it.
Hesitation.
Why?
He has seen death in the eye many times. He does not fear it. Why should he hesitate?
But the Lifebone...
How many people could it guide home?
Ascalon throws herself at Manfred in his moment of hesitation.
The two of them fall into the turbulence together.

options: Right here, where the mountain's energies are most focused.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This will cause an extreme, uncontrolled Originium chain-reaction.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Get ready, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ready—
Black Arts penetrate the mountainous Originium.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The collapse has begun.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Run!
You grab Mon3tr's claw, an action that has become second-nature. Mon3tr screeches joyfully and begins to run.
Behind you is the terrifying roar of destructive energy running rampant.
The violent chain-reaction causes everything around you to tremble.
The legions of Nachzehrers follow the trembling.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Sudaram are chasing us!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't fight them! Don't let them bog you down!
Warriors wrapped in tattered banners swarm upon you. Many of them are swallowed by the Originium chain-reaction, but even more join the ranks of your pursuers.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Unhappy Whining)
Sudaram entangle Mon3tr. You hear their hollow breathing echo in your ear.
The Nachzehrer warriors are trying to drag all of you into the pit of death.
'Shadows of conflict, yield to conflict.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Trust your elite operators, Doctor.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: They'll show up when you need them the most.

options: I know I can count on you.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Don't let your guard down.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I sense turmoil in the fabric of reality. The Feranmut is coming.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I will attempt to create a waypoint to help us board the skeleton.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Jump down from the cliff.

options: I'm beginning to regret what I just said.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Time is of the essence.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Doctor, Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit... now.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Jump.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Drive the Feranmut! I'll take care of the Royal Court soldiers!

steps.name: W
steps.text: A-Am I driving?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ok, Bonesy, er, go to where the biggest commotion is.
There is no response. The muddled voice says nothing. Perhaps it just cannot be bothered.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's not gonna send it inside the barrel of some super-gun, is it?
The intangible tide fades.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It really sent us right into the middle of an explosion.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I think I'm beginning to enjoy this.
Threads of silver-white incantation snag the drifting Feranmut, and several figures fall into the room.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bunny? Banshee?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You made it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha...

options: It takes an explosion to catch the attention of a bomb maniac.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not bad. You actually made it out of the Confessarii's evil ritual alive.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Bonesy is fine, as you can see.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hoederer took a hit from Manfred's sword, but he's still breathing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: As for the others...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We found no trace of Ascalon or Manfred on the skeleton.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She got tangled with Manfred and didn't make it in time when the skeleton took off.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Ascalon's ability is beyond question.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You can trust her as you trust me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Crying won't change anything. We have stuff to do.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's the next step?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've already drawn too much attention. We need to drift, now.
